32:       ['Peptide bonds between molecules', false, 'Peptide bonds link amino acids in proteins. Water molecules attract each other mainly through hydrogen bonds.'],
33:       ['They share electrons permanently', false, 'Water’s O–H bonds are polar covalent, but neighboring water molecules do not share electrons with each other. They form hydrogen bonds.'],

## Objective
- Expand the biochemistry game with focused-topic chapters, including separate molecular biology chapters, while keeping it playable.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game and keep it complete and playable.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Split molecular biology into DNA & Replication, Gene Expression, RNA & Translation, and Genes & Inheritance.
- Keep five questions per run and reuse appropriately grouped questions from the existing genetics bank.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added three focused-topic chapters and renamed the existing Molecular Biology chapter to Genes & Inheritance in `game.js`.
- Grouped the supplemental genetics questions into the new chapter banks in `bank-a.js`.
- Updated chapter counts and pathway copy in `index.html` from six to nine chapters.
- `node --check game.js` and `node --check bank-a.js` passed.

### Active
- Verify chapter selection, question availability, and gameplay; perform the requested visual check.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game and confirm all nine chapters load and can complete a five-question run.
2. Save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.
3. Report the topic-grouping assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Chapter definitions, question assembly, and gameplay.
- `bank-a.js`: Supplemental question banks and new molecular-topic grouping.
- `index.html`: Chapter counts and pathway copy.
- `styles.css`: Chapter-picker layout and responsive styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Questions are assembled from built-in chapter questions and `window.bankA[item.id]`, capped at 40 per chapter.

## Objective
- Expand the biochemistry game with focused-topic chapters, including separate molecular biology chapters, while keeping it playable.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game and keep it complete and playable.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Split molecular biology into DNA & Replication, Gene Expression, RNA & Translation, and Genes & Inheritance.
- Keep five questions per run and reuse appropriately grouped questions from the existing genetics bank.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added three focused-topic chapters and renamed the existing Molecular Biology chapter to Genes & Inheritance in `game.js`.
- Grouped supplemental genetics questions into the new chapter banks in `bank-a.js`.
- Updated chapter counts and pathway copy in `index.html` from six to nine chapters.
- Passed `node --check game.js` and `node --check bank-a.js`.
- Browser-tested all nine chapters: each loaded a five-question run and reached the completion screen.

### Active
- Complete the requested visual check by saving and inspecting a JPEG screenshot (maximum width 1280px).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Capture the chapter picker or gameplay as a JPEG no wider than 1280px and inspect only that latest screenshot.
2. Check for any remaining chapter-copy or question-grouping issues, then report assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Chapter definitions, question assembly, and gameplay.
- `bank-a.js`: Supplemental question banks and molecular-topic grouping.
- `index.html`: Chapter counts and pathway copy.
- `styles.css`: Chapter-picker layout and responsive styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Questions are assembled from built-in chapter questions and `window.bankA[item.id]`, capped at 40 per chapter.
- During testing all nine chapters completed; scores varied because the test selected the first answer each time.
